question: Hamideh Banu Maryam Makani was the wife of Mughal emperor ______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Humayun.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Hamideh Banu Maryam Makani was the wife of Mughal emperor Humayun.**
 
• Hamida Banu Begum was chief and most favourite consort of the second Mughal emperor Humayun&
